# ankra_stack_profiles (Data Source)

Lists the stack profiles the organisation can see: its own, public ones, and ones shared with it. The counterpart of `ankra stack-profiles list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_stack_profiles" "all" {}

output "own_profiles" {
  value = [for profile in data.ankra_stack_profiles.all.profiles : profile.name if profile.is_owner]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `profiles` (Attributes List) Stack profiles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Catalogue category.
- `current_version` (Number) The version new deployments get.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the profile.
- `is_owner` (Boolean) Whether the organisation owns the profile.
- `latest_version` (Number) The newest published version.
- `name` (String) Profile name.
- `organisation_id` (String) Organisation that owns the profile.
- `publisher_slug` (String) Slug of the publishing organisation.
- `shared_with_you` (Boolean) Whether the profile is visible through a share grant.
- `tags` (List of String) Catalogue tags.
- `visibility` (String) `organisation` or `public`.
